name: The road beyond Greyfen
greeting: Wind crosses the road without forming a voice. A patch of earth where oathgrass grew is bare.
lines: Kael kneels and presses a seed into the ordinary soil. He cannot make it take root by promising.
Kael: We can water it. We can come back.
The destroyed witness cannot answer the questions no one thought to ask. The human record can still accuse the powerful. The living can still choose what they owe each other.
Kael stands. The quiet is relief, and it is absence. He carries both toward Greyfen.
Your campaign outcome is kept. Greyfen and the discovered roads remain open for unfinished conversations and work.
